---
description: "CA/EN/ES translation conventions"
applyTo: "src/i18n/**/*.ts,src/utils/i18n*.ts,src/utils/locale.ts"
---

# i18n

- **CA** is SSR default (`t()` from `src/utils/i18n.ts`). Also maintain **EN** and **ES**.
- Locale files: `src/i18n/{ca,en,es}.ts` — flat string maps; keep keys identical across locales
- Languages in the toggle: `SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES` in `src/utils/constants.ts`
- Project strings: `projects.${i}.description`, `.longDescription`, `.highlights.${j}`
- `src/tests/i18n/keys.test.ts` enforces key parity — run tests after adding keys
